From curl's `lib/urldata.h`, the Negotiate auth state constants are defined in sequence — `CURL_NEGO_AUTH_NONE 0`, `CURL_NEGO_AUTH_STARTED 1`, `CURL_NEGO_AUTH_SENT 2`, `CURL_NEGO_AUTH_DONE 3` (referenced when marking the Authorization header as sent in the SPNEGO state machine, `lib/vauth/negotiate.c` / `lib/http.c`).

Note: I'm offline and answering from memory of the curl source, so this reflects the state as of my knowledge rather than a live check of the current dev tree.
